versions.changelog:
Initial release of Clawdy Selfie skill.

- Generates and sends selfies of "Clawdy" using a fixed reference image and xAI Grok Imagine via fal.ai.
- Auto-selects selfie prompt style (mirror or direct) based on user request/context.
- Sends generated images to messaging platforms (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, etc.) through OpenClaw.
- Includes example Bash script, API usage, and quick-start setup details.
- Supports context-aware selfies (outfits, locations, expressions).
